rules.text:
HOW TO PLAY
CLUE™
Step 1,
Purchase a Ticket

Find an Arizona Lottery retailer and tell the cashier you’d like to purchase a Clue™ ticket. Tickets cannot be purchased online.

Step 2,
How to Play

Match any of YOUR SYMBOLS to any of the WINNING SYMBOLS, win prize shown for that symbol. Reveal a ""
symbol, win DOUBLE the prize for that symbol.

BONUS: Reveal a "" symbol, win prize shown.

Step 3,
Claim Your Winnings

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.
